backtest.strong: Model vs the OPENING line, gap 3+: 59.5% (2008-21, 622 bets, SBR openers) and 65% (2023-25, 358 bets, Monday openers); the closing line moved our way 1.2 pts on average
backtest.close: Against the CLOSING line the same picks were 52-56%: most of the edge is getting the early number
backtest.weather: Wind 15+ mph at an open-air stadium: unders hit 58% (2008-13), 56% (2014-19) and 56% (2020-25) vs the CLOSING total (435 games)
backtest.teaser: 6-pt teaser underdogs +1.5 to +2.5, total 49.5 or less: legs won 75% (2008-13), 77% (2014-19), 78% (2020-25); a 2-team teaser at -120 needs 73.9% per leg
backtest.rlm: Reverse line movement (57%+ of bets one way, line moves 1+ pt the other way), graded at the closing line 2018-25: 150-158 (48.7%). No variant beat 52.4% in both periods
backtest.trend: This-season trends (6+ games at 80%+): 154-129 overall but 64-68 (48.5%) since 2019
backtest.angles: Situations that beat the closing line in both 2007-15 and 2016-25: playoff underdogs (56%), underdogs off a 20+ point loss (55%), fading dome teams outdoors below 35F (55%), fading teams 3+ net covers hot (53%)
backtest.td: TD model (red-zone and touch share x team implied TDs) on 2022-25: log loss 0.475 vs 0.484 for the old board's recipe; well calibrated
